% Highlight box styles using SnapLogic brand colors (clean design with top rule only)
\newcommand{\infobox}[1]{%
    \par\vspace{8pt}\noindent%
    \setlength{\fboxsep}{15pt}%
    \colorbox{snapBlue!10}{%
        \begin{minipage}{\dimexpr\linewidth-2\fboxsep\relax}%
            \textcolor{snapBlue}{\rule{\linewidth}{2pt}}\\[6pt]%
            #1%
        \end{minipage}%
    }%
    \par\vspace{8pt}%
}

\newcommand{\successbox}[1]{%

    }%

}

% KPI/Metric boxes - Small, centered, bold colored backgrounds with white text (inline, 4 per row)
\newcommand{\kpibox}[3]{%
    % Args: color, title, value
    \setlength{\fboxsep}{15pt}%
    \colorbox{#1}{%
        \begin{minipage}[c][80pt]{0.18\linewidth}%
            \centering%
            \textcolor{white}{\large\textbf{#2}}\\[10pt]%
            \textcolor{white}{\LARGE\textbf{#3}}%
        \end{minipage}%
    }%
    \hspace{0.006\linewidth}%
}

% Feature card boxes - Subtle colored backgrounds with black text, 3 per row, squared
\newcommand{\featurebox}[3]{%
    % Args: color, title, content
    \setlength{\fboxsep}{15pt}%
    \colorbox{#1!15}{%
        \begin{minipage}[t][130pt][t]{0.265\linewidth}%
            \raggedright%
            {\large\textbf{#2}}\\[6pt]%
            {\normalsize #3}%
        \end{minipage}%
    }\hspace{0.0065\linewidth}%
}

% Badge boxes - Small inline colored boxes with white text (for requirement tracking)
\newcommand{\badgebox}[2]{%
    % Args: color, text
    \setlength{\fboxsep}{3pt}%
    \colorbox{#1}{%
        \textcolor{white}{\small\textbf{#2}}%
    }%
}
